item: The light pressure snapshots also fire on swap in use and on available memory below a share of the RAM read now
summary: An instance with swap full for hours took no light snapshot because the trigger only read the memory guard's line, which comes from the RAM read at boot (a VM whose RAM the host took back keeps the boot numbers). Two triggers read this tick's memory: swap holding at least max(256 MB, 5% of RAM now), and available memory below the heavy line (15% of RAM now, at most 1,024 MB). Each number's reason is in the code; the swap case is tested with RAM headroom left and goes red without the trigger.
